deterministic: Each mode is driven by a fixed seed (seed=1): fixed spawns, fixed bot poses, a fixed number of 60 Hz sim ticks, two renders, then window.__shotReady and a freeze. The same seed gives the same pixels every run.

shots.caption: Buy phase: the buy menu open over the Ember spawn view, the foundry floor and mid crates readable behind it.
Mid-round firefight: crosshair on an Anvil defender, muzzle flash and tracer, full HUD (health, ammo, timer, score, money).
Device planted at Site A (Furnace Hall): bomb glow, fuse bar, a defender rotating in to defuse.
Round won: the banner over Furnace Hall with the score updated to 1-0.
